details:
With the ability to block avatars globally, it is a little redundant to use the user-specific avatar block button as it exists now. 

There exists times, especially in game worlds, where fully blocking someone is not necessarily a good course of action as it gets in the way of the game (e.g. unable to see the murderer in Murder, only a floating knife). 

I propose an option to enforce personal space specifically on a certain individual so that if they are getting in your face or trying to touch your avatar inappropriately, they would stop seeing you and, therefore, hopefully stop their actions. 

To my understanding personal space, as it is now, is a local option (only affecting you) that would not stop someone from doing these acts, just leave you blissfully unaware of what they are doing. Personal space is also a blanket option right now that affects every remote player equally, but that's a different thing entirely. 

The reason I propose this option be linked to blocking an avatar is due to the aforementioned redundancy that the show/block avatar part of the menu currently has due to the more general usefulness of the block avatar globally button, though of course an additional button specifically for it would serve the same purpose.
title: Force Personal Space-like setting for others upon blocking their avatar.
